reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides isolated CloakBrowser sessions for agent-driven webpage navigation, interaction, bounded extraction, tab management, and screenshots, with configurable persistence and network controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 CloakBrowser 的隔离浏览器会话，用于网页导航、交互、内容提取、标签页管理和截图。
summaries.en: Provides isolated CloakBrowser sessions for DeepSeek Harness agents to navigate and interact with webpages, extract bounded content, manage tabs, and capture screenshots.

capabilities: Opens and navigates Chromium browser sessions
Clicks, types, selects, presses keys, waits, and interacts with web pages
Extracts bounded page text, HTML, and attributes
Captures screenshots and provides image attachments
Supports per-Agent isolated or explicitly persistent browser profiles
Supports proxy configuration and domain allow or deny rules
